mapper.select: SELECT kc.id, kc.article_id, kc.content, ka.title, ka.species, ka.topic, ka.source_title, ka.source_url, ka.publisher, ka.reviewed_on, MATCH(kc.content) AGAINST(#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) AS relevance FROM knowledge_chunks AS kc INNER JOIN knowledge_articles AS ka ON kc.article_id = ka.id WHERE ka.review_status = 'published' AND ka.reviewed_on IS NOT NULL AND (ka.species = 'all' OR ka.species = #{species}) AND MATCH(kc.content) AGAINST(#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) > 0 ORDER BY relevance DESC, ka.reviewed_on DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, title, species, topic, summary, source_title, source_url, publisher, published_on, reviewed_on, review_status, reviewer_id, created_at, updated_at FROM knowledge_articles WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT kc.id, kc.article_id, kc.chunk_order, kc.content, ka.title, ka.species, ka.topic, ka.source_title, ka.source_url, ka.publisher, ka.reviewed_on FROM knowledge_chunks AS kc INNER JOIN knowledge_articles AS ka ON kc.article_id = ka.id WHERE kc.article_id = #{articleId} ORDER BY kc.chunk_order ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_articles SET title = #{title}, species = #{species}, topic = #{topic}, summary = #{summary}, source_title = #{sourceTitle}, source_url = #{sourceUrl}, publisher = #{publisher}, published_on = #{publishedOn}, reviewed_on = #{reviewedOn}, review_status = #{reviewStatus}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_chunks (article_id, chunk_order, content, search_keywords) VALUES (#{articleId}, #{chunkOrder}, #{content}, #{searchKeywords})
